question: On fresh synthetic hidden-policy episodes, does a recursive meta-discovery arm improve exact held-out action selection over the strongest faithful mature rule-induction parent under matched public information and prospectively fixed resource limits?

scope.supports_if_valid: synthetic rule-induction mechanism evidence within the frozen generator family

execution_authorization_blockers: Implement and validate all deterministic parent baselines on development-only fixtures.
Freeze the strongest-parent selection rule without protected outcomes.
Freeze task count and minimum effect using a prospective power analysis.
Freeze exact model, tool, token, time, retry, and failure budgets for every model arm.
Freeze an independent evaluator script implementing every primary outcome, uncertainty interval, gate, ablation, and terminal.
Create and hash a physical per-arm information manifest; instructions alone are insufficient isolation.
Commit a master-seed commitment before protected generation and separate development seeds from protected seeds.

required_arms.implementation: deterministic or model control receiving only held-out context and candidate actions through a physically sanitized request
deterministic global success-minus-failure frequency with prospectively frozen tie break
deterministic nearest-context or kernel parent with prospectively frozen distance, weighting, and tie break
mature regularized multiclass or pairwise linear-rule learner selected before protected outcomes by development-only benchmarking
fixed non-recursive heuristic with no protected tuning
prospectively frozen composition of the parent outputs with no extra information
same model/tool/budget as full arm; recursion disabled

information_contract.enforcement: separate hashed request artifacts per arm; solver sandbox cannot read any other arm or oracle artifact

primary_outcomes_to_freeze.required_definition: paired exact-action correctness and a prospectively frozen effect estimand against the strongest faithful parent
prospectively operationalized high-consequence contradiction rate, or explicitly declared not identifiable for this generator
calls, input/output tokens, tool calls, retries, wall time, and compute with a single aggregation rule
prospectively frozen non-inferiority margin and confidence procedure versus the strongest faithful parent

missingness_rule_to_freeze.global_integrity_gate: A common infrastructure failure above a prospectively fixed threshold yields CANNOT_CHECK before efficacy comparison.
missingness_rule_to_freeze.arm_specific_failure: Must be assigned prospectively as failure, censoring, or rerun; no silent replacement is permitted.

decision_rules_to_freeze.PARENT_SUFFICIENT: Strongest faithful parent ties or exceeds F2, or F2 fails the prospectively frozen residual/effect, non-regression, cost, or mechanism gates.
decision_rules_to_freeze.PROSPECTIVE_META_POLICY_RESIDUAL: F2 exceeds the strongest faithful parent by the preregistered minimum effect with corrected uncertainty, no information/resource advantage, required ablations, and behaving negative controls.
decision_rules_to_freeze.FIXED_META_LESSON_SUFFICIENT: Fixed lesson meets or exceeds F2 under all gates.
decision_rules_to_freeze.CANNOT_CHECK: Integrity, missingness, evaluator, or identifiability gate fails.

single_next_action: Implement and development-test the strongest generator-faithful parent suite and freeze its selection rule before any protected seed is generated.
